item.title: Agrish Reannounces and Expands Recall of Adult Portable Bed Rails Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Entrapment and Asphyxiation; Violate Mandatory Standard for Adult Portable Bed Rails; Additional Units Added
item.company: Zhongshan Lebo Medical Co., Ltd., of China
item.brand: Zhongshan Lebo Medical Co., Ltd., of China
item.product: Agrish Adult Portable Bed Rails, models 12014, AG-12011 and 12016
item.summary: This recall involves Agrish-branded adult portable bed rails, models AG-12011, 12014 and 12016, for use on adult beds. The model numbers are printed in the owner’s manual and labeled on the bed rail’s metal post. The recalled bed rails have white tubing with rounded gray foam rubber handle grips. Each model has multiple batch numbers and manufacture dates listed on the unit and the instruction manual.
item.affectedPeople: Consumers who purchased: Agrish Adult Portable Bed Rails, models 12014, AG-12011 and 12016.
item.remedy: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled adult portable bed rails and contact Agrish Direct for a full refund. Consumers will be asked to go to http://www.agrish.online/recall to register for the recall and receive instructions on how to dispose of the recalled bed rail.
item.payoutAmount: Repair, refund, replacement, or other remedy if stated by the CPSC notice
